titulo: Every Orange Hides a Flammable Secret
tema: Why does an orange peel smell so strong, and what is hidden in that smell?
estilo_visual: award-winning photorealistic nature photography, natural light, shallow depth of field, sharp focus, rich warm colors

audio.como_ler: picos_cortados.trechos > 0 = distorção; silencios = buraco de 0,7 s ou mais no meio do vídeo; saltos_volume = volume muda 6 LU ou mais em 1 s; voz_abafada = trecho em que a música (ou ruído) preenche os vãos da fala (heurística: confirme pela transcrição)

cenas.narracao: Every orange is covered in tiny bottles of flammable oil.
cenas.quadro: A single ripe orange with bright orange dimpled peel hanging on the branch of a citrus tree in a sunny orchard, glossy dark green leaves around it, background softly blurred

cenas.narracao: Each tiny dot on the peel is an oil gland.
cenas.quadro: Medium-close view of the bright orange dimpled peel of a ripe orange on a citrus tree branch, tiny round pores glistening with oil in warm sunlight, dark green leaf at the edge, background blurred

cenas.narracao: Bend the peel, and those glands burst into a fine, fragrant mist.
cenas.quadro: A curled strip of bright orange citrus peel resting on a dark wooden table, a faint glowing mist of fine oil droplets hanging in the air above it, backlit by warm window light, dark background

cenas.narracao: That bright smell comes mostly from one molecule, called limonene.
cenas.quadro: A halved ripe orange with juicy segments and thick bright orange peel resting on a dark wooden table beside a glossy green citrus leaf, warm side light, background blurred

cenas.narracao: The tree makes it as armor. Many insects stay away.
cenas.quadro: A ripe orange with bright orange dimpled peel on the branch of a citrus tree, a small green beetle resting still on a nearby glossy dark green leaf, soft morning light, background blurred

cenas.narracao: But that perfume has a secret. Near a flame, it sparks.
cenas.quadro: A lit candle with a small steady flame on a dark wooden table, a curled strip of bright orange citrus peel resting beside it, tiny glowing sparks floating in the warm light, dark background

cenas.narracao: Stranger still, this molecule comes in two shapes, like mirror images.
cenas.quadro: A single ripe orange with bright orange dimpled peel resting on the edge of a still dark pond, its perfect reflection on the calm water surface, soft evening light, background blurred

cenas.narracao: One shape smells like oranges. Its mirror twin smells like pine.
cenas.quadro: A ripe orange with bright orange dimpled peel resting on green moss beside a brown pine cone and a green pine branch with long needles, forest floor, soft light, background blurred

cenas.narracao: Every orange wears armor made of perfume that can burn.
cenas.quadro: A single ripe orange with bright orange dimpled peel hanging on the branch of a citrus tree at golden sunset, glossy dark green leaves glowing at the edges, background softly blurred
